evidence.reason: The launch record write is outside the try/except that stops the spawned process and scope. If Recorder.append raises after Popen, boot() exits without terminating/reaping the child or closing the log, so the pending systemd-run/QEMU process can survive after the run lock is released. Moving the append into the existing try keeps the successful-path record while guaranteeing cleanup on write failure; this is an ordinary error-path correctness fix, not a new requirement.
